incident_spec.summary: PostgreSQL performance degradation observed, with operations taking 4x longer than before.
symptoms: Database backup duration increased from ~1 hour to ~4 hours.
Replication sync duration increased from ~1 hour to ~4 hours.
Queries that previously took seconds now hang for days unless work_mem is increased.
High memory usage and swapping observed on server B.
incident_spec.mechanism: Potential misconfiguration or resource contention affecting PostgreSQL performance.

facts.evidence: Post includes PostgreSQL version and configuration details.
Post includes Linux kernel settings and disk scheduler configuration.
Post includes memory usage statistics for server B.

assumptions: The performance degradation is related to PostgreSQL configuration or Linux kernel settings.
Transparent Huge Pages and cfq scheduler may be contributing factors.
unknowns: Exact root cause of the performance degradation.
Impact of other workloads on the database performance.
